source_reading: Near and wide views support the same continuous curved ground-floor entrance. The model uses a bounded central section, not the whole colonnade. Proportions, curve, thickness, ornament and steps remain estimates.
simplifications: Four low platform levels are a display approximation, not measured stair count.
Simplified fluting/capitals, no fine carving or lettering.
Frames, glazing, three portal frames and pediments are surface colors, not relief or transparent openings.
Back panel closes the unknown interior for a display solid; sides/back/top are explicit cuts.

views.observation: Seven columns and three visible portal color regions; ivory curved entablature, gray-green glazing and gray stepped platform. End and upper cuts are visible. Column flutes/capitals are simplified.
Neutral closed display backing and cut ends; not an assertion about the real building backside. No hidden windows or unobserved details added.
Curved crop and four-level display platform; roof-like top is explicitly a section cut, not the actual teaching-building roof.
Four prototype types and ten physical pieces are separated: platform, seven columns, backing and entablature. Display offsets are not a print layout.
